long_biography.plain_text:
In 1996, Uri Ginzburg's son Daniel left legal practice to take over the running of FantaSea Yachts, the charter company his father had founded. Daniel had learned the business through practical jobs, working as a cleaner, waiter and event coordinator. His wife, Stephanie, became the company's creative director.

The enterprise has also kept employees across generations. Some staff have spent decades there, with their children joining the serving team during summer holidays. Its internal progression has seen dishwashers become chefs and crew members become captains. Recommendations and referrals remain central to winning new bookings.
